== Description ==
'''Jimmy''' Is an entity that can spawn in any section. Having a 1 in 2000 chance of spawning.

== Appearance ==
'''Jimmy''' looks a face with insanely dark. Eyes are very small white pupils. The head isn't fully black and has some gray and transparency.

== Behavior ==
Upon a door is opened past A-000, there will be a 1 in 2000 chance for '''Jimmy''' to be behind the door, it will hiss very loudly before disappearing.

== Trivia ==
* Locker '''Jimmy''' has been removed.
* Jimmy, along with [[Mori]], [[False Witness]], [[Tackle]], and [[False-60]] as invaders are the rarest normal entities within the game.
